newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit eases slightly on commercial dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit eases slightly on commercial dollar demand.

text.p: The ringgit ended slightly lower as commercial demand for the U.S. dollar continued into the afternoon, dealers said on Wednesday.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5040/45 a dollar against 2.5022/26 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday. It was at 1.7759/69 a Singapore dollar against 1.7734/54.
"There was some commercial demand out of kuala Lumpur," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
He said many banks which were caught short dollar on Tuesday were also covering their positions.
Dealers said the large commercial demand was expected to continue for a few days and pull down the ringgit further.
"We expect a very large demand for dollars to come through for a large infrastructure project soon," a Singapore-based U.S. bank dealer said.
